description: Channel-routed `send` — pushes a message via the gateway's delivery layer. Wire format (verified live against gateway 2026.4.12+): requires `to` (channel-specific recipient) + `idempotencyKey` (auto-generated if omitted). Prefer the typed `openclaw_chat_send` or `openclaw_sessions_send` when you want session context.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key to dedupe retries. Auto-generated UUID if omitted.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

to.description: Channel-specific recipient (e.g. Telegram chat id, Discord channel id, email address).

name: openclaw_send
